profile.name: Amel Kifane
profile.title: Frontend Web Developer & AI Master's Student
profile.tagline: I build clean, responsive, pixel-perfect interfaces — and I'm learning to make them smarter.
profile.bio: I'm a Frontend Web Developer based in Algeria, currently pursuing a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence (M2) at Tissemsilt University. I specialize in building modern, accessible, responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Tailwind CSS.
profile.longBio: My journey in tech started with a curiosity about how websites work — a curiosity that turned into years of hands-on experience building everything from static landing pages to modern, interactive interfaces with React and Tailwind CSS. Currently, I'm deepening my knowledge in Artificial Intelligence as part of my Master's program, exploring how machine learning can enhance user interfaces and make them more adaptive and intelligent. I've earned certifications from Microsoft and Cisco in web development and cybersecurity, and I'm always eager to take on new challenges.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A fully responsive portfolio website with dark/light mode, admin panel, and dynamic content management.
projects.longDescription: Built this portfolio to showcase my work and skills. Features include: dark/light mode, scroll animations, a full admin dashboard for managing projects and certificates, a contact form with EmailJS integration, and a review system.

projects.title: EnergyCare — Energy Management Platform
projects.description: A smart platform for managing energy consumption, with bill tracking, meter readings, and complaint submission for users, plus a full dashboard for admins.
projects.longDescription: EnergyCare is a smart energy-management platform. Users can view and track their electricity bills, submit meter readings, and file complaints directly through the platform. Administrators get a complete dashboard to manage all registered users and send them notifications. Key features: bills, meter readings, complaints, notifications, and an admin dashboard.

projects.title: Auto-Accessory — Store Management System
projects.description: A complete management system for a car-accessories store, covering suppliers, profit tracking, credit accounts, and a full admin dashboard.
projects.longDescription: Auto-Accessory is an integrated management system built for a car-accessories store. It includes a full admin dashboard, supplier management, profit tracking, credit accounts, and alerts — a professional platform to organize the store's buying and selling operations. Key features: suppliers, profits, credit accounts, alerts, and an admin dashboard.

projects.title: University Supervision Platform
projects.description: An academic supervision platform connecting professors and students, where students submit projects and request supervision, and professors accept, reject, and message them.
projects.longDescription: University Supervision links professors with students on one platform. Students can submit their projects and send supervision requests, while professors can accept or reject those requests and communicate directly with students. It includes role-based access for professors, students, and admins, along with messaging and notifications. Key features: projects, supervision requests, messages, notifications, and roles (professor/student/admin).

projects.title: Eshop — Online Store
projects.description: A modern online store that showcases products in an attractive way — a simple, easy-to-use shopping platform for browsing and selling products online.
projects.longDescription: Eshop is a modern e-commerce storefront that presents products in a visually appealing layout. It's a simple, user-friendly shopping platform designed for browsing and selling products online, with a fully responsive design. Key features: products, shopping experience, attractive display, and responsive design.
